title: Chapter 1356
text:
Bang! Colorful lights spread out in all directions with the point of collision as the center. The scene was like a supernova explosion.

The energy tsunami created by the combined power of more than two hundred Beyond Grade As swallowed a large number of fleets all at once. The sudden burst of high-energy reaction alarmed countless battleship radars on this battlefield, instantly becoming the most eye-catching area in the entire war zone.

Beams of light from the surface of the Mechanical Deity bombarded an emerald green meteor one after another, but they were unable to penetrate the defense of this layer of protective flames. All of them exploded into light fragments on the shield.

The Subduing Tree King, who was wrapped in green flames, circulated his energy and raised his hand to punch out. His fist, which was flickering with a dazzling light, hit the blade of the Celestial Punishment Edge heavily. A violent shockwave immediately exploded at the point of contact, producing a loud buzzing sound that echoed in the depths of the soul of a living being.

"Outsider, it's really you." The Subduing Tree King raised his hand to block the Celestial Punishment Edge and released a cold mental wave.

Han Xiao could not be bothered to guess what the other party was thinking. Mechanical Force surged all over his body, and he activated the Getta Hadoken. The Celestial Punishment Edge maintained its momentum, and psionic energy gushed out along the blade. The powerful dark blue shockwave sent the Subduing Tree King flying.

However, the next moment, the Subduing Tree King stopped in his tracks, turned around, and charged forward again, continuing to face the Mechanical Deity's attack head-on.

His fists and legs brought about swift shadows, and an emerald green shockwave gushed out endlessly. It condensed to the point that it was almost materialized, and it was like a spear of light stabbing into the psionic shield of the Mechanical Deity. With the support of the World Tree, the Subduing Tree King's protective flames were like indestructible Vajra. Countless electric arcs and energy sparks continuously exploded in the head-on collision.

The blade of the Celestial Punishment Edge swept up a wave of dark blue psionic energy, and each slash was faster than the last. In the blink of an eye, it collided with the Subduing Tree King more than a thousand times. The two of them kept merging at high speed, and the stacking of various force fields caused the surrounding space to slightly bend and dislocate.

"If not for the fact that it's not suitable to use the chat tactic, I would have given you a few sentences …"

Han Xiao pursed his lips and suppressed the urge to send a message and shout the name of the move.

While fighting, he was also keeping his eyes and ears open, observing the situation.

In this kind of battlefield, there was no such thing as a tacit understanding of not fighting against high-level combatants. The countless warships in the surroundings did not stop their attacks. Large numbers of troops poured into this war zone, forming a crisscrossing formation.

However, the fleets on both sides wanted to kill the high-level combatants of the enemy while protecting their own experts. Thus, they formed a stalemate, indirectly giving the Beyond Grade As of both sides room to maneuver.

It was also because of this that the many Mechanics, including Han Xiao, did not summon too many mechanical troops. Otherwise, if the target was too big, they would have to endure the concentrated fire of the surrounding fleets, which would cause a lot of extra losses. It was not worth it to use good steel on the blade.

Swoosh!

Just as he was analyzing the situation, the Subduing Tree King's body suddenly shone brightly, and he used his Pugilist technique. His charging speed suddenly increased, and he headed straight for the Mechanical Deity's torso. It was as if his entire body had suddenly become indestructible, and he actually smashed through the psionic shield. The green meteor struck the Mechanical Deity's abdomen armor, creating a huge crater and large cracks.

Then, the Subduing Tree King's head suddenly spun in the middle of the crater, as if it was going to turn into a drill to drill through the Mechanical Deity. Obviously, his head was not made of ordinary metal.

However, at this moment, large amounts of black nanoparticles suddenly seeped out from the crater in the Mechanical Deity's abdomen armor. They quickly condensed and transformed into countless mechanical tentacles that lashed out at the Subduing Tree King. The bearings carried out mechanical transmission, and when the force reached the end, the tentacles suddenly tightened. They turned from whips into spears, and a neat round of stabs pierced into the Subduing Tree King's protective aura, pushing him out.

Then, Han Xiao turned the hilt of his blade and slapped the other party like he was swatting a fly. The Subduing Tree King was sent flying, knocking over three to four Beyond Grade As who were fighting along the way.

"You still want to enter my body? Dream on." Han Xiao patted the abdomen of the Mechanical Deity, and the crater quickly recovered.

Pugilists basically killed the main body or the Lord's Avatar when dealing with Mechanics. This was the most efficient operation. The Subduing Tree King wanted to enter the body of the Mechanical Deity and attack his main body.

Although he had caused a ruckus in the World Tree territory the last time and lasted for about ten minutes under the siege of more than a hundred Beyond Grade As, it was still not enough for the World Tree experts to completely accept his tankiness. They would still try to attack his main body.

After all, the three Universal Civilizations had accepted the title of the Indestructible Body because they had witnessed Han Xiao's achievements over the years. However, this information was not circulated in the World Tree. Han Xiao had only displayed his tankiness once in the other party's territory before retreating with heavy injuries. Therefore, most of the World Tree experts still did not know much about Han Xiao and would not easily give up on attacking his main body.

"The combat strength of a Tree King is indeed extraordinary. I won't be able to take him down in a short time."

Han Xiaoxin thought.

The last time they fought, he did not experience the full strength of the Subduing Tree King. Now that he looked at it, the other party was indeed not simple. Before Carrott was fully formed, the Subduing Tree King was undoubtedly above all the Pugilists he had encountered so far. Beast Ancestor, Gorután, and Star Crusher Sierron were all little brothers in front of him. If they fought, they would probably not survive a day in the Subduing Tree King's hands.

However, even if the Subduing Tree King was a ferocious man, his strength was still above his head.

At the same time, the Subduing Tree King perfectly met the criteria of being a peak Beyond Grade A elder of the World Tree Faction. On the interface, the four talents of [World Tree Nemesis], [Civilization Leader Assassin], [Elderly Killer], and [Fearless Heart] lit up at the same time.

"Fight steadily and defeat him." Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

He had the advantage in terms of combat strength and class, but the Subduing Tree King was not to be trifled with. He could still exchange a few blows with him, so he would not be able to take him down in a short time.

The two of them fought fiercely, and light waves shot out in all directions. The other Beyond Grade As were also in a chaotic battle.

The energy released by so many Beyond Grade As kept pushing the others away, causing their battlefields to gradually move away from each other. Although most of them did not have the intention to fight one-on-one, both sides wanted to defeat each other one by one. However, they could support each other, so they naturally formed small groups to fight fiercely.

…

Bang!

Mechanic Emperor's trident stabbed forward and was blocked by a broad-faced greatsword. The psionic energy wrapped in Mechanical Force collided with each other and exploded into a spherical light blue energy ball.

The two Mechanical Deities were evenly matched, like two blurry afterimages colliding constantly. Shockwaves frequently burst out. One of them was silver, and the other was golden-red with green energy wrapped around its body. The color scheme was extremely bullsh * t.

"What a sharp guy …"

Manison pushed his opponent away with his trident and narrowed his eyes.

He had already learned from Black Star that the individual strength of the World Tree was very developed, but only after fighting did he personally experience how powerful the other party was.

Although he was no longer at his peak after suffering a series of blows from Black Star, he was still firmly in the first tier. Ordinary peak Beyond Grade As were still no match for him. However, this enemy was now fighting back and forth with him, even making him feel quite a bit of pressure. Even though Manison felt that his strength was slightly stronger than the other party, it was not enough to create an overwhelming advantage.

Furthermore, this person was not in the information provided by Han Xiao about the hundreds of World Tree experts. He was a strong enemy with an unknown background.

Just as Manison was thinking, the other party suddenly sent out a mental wave in his heart.

"You're very powerful. What's your name?"

Hearing this, Manison was unmoved and did not reply.

Although he did not receive an answer, the other party did not stop and continued to send out mental messages.

"It doesn't matter if you don't say it. I've got my eyes on you. You have the qualifications to be my spoils of war, World Tree Trilemma Executive Officer Lynn Karen. Remember this name. Your life is destined to be mine."

"You talk too much."

Manison was unperturbed. Such flirtatious words had no effect on him.

After being influenced by Black Star, he was no longer afraid of chatting.

However, he remembered the other party's name. According to Black Star, the ten Executive Officers were all at the top of the World Tree. The higher they were ranked, the more powerful they were. Trilemma was in the first tier of the World Tree experts, and she would definitely have a place in the top fifteen.

"Looks like a big fish …"

Manison's eyes flashed, and he silently increased his strength. His attacks became more and more ruthless, and his killing intent overflowed.

…

In a certain part of the battlefield, two torrents of energy, one black and one white, collided with each other, causing endless light to splash like water.

Dark Emperor Clottey controlled the surging dark energy and was fighting with a slender World Tree member.

The other party was also an Esper. He controlled a dazzling white energy that was like flowing platinum. Its texture was as elegant as a veil, like a rolling fog, but its power was extremely corrosive.

"What Esper Ability is this? It's on par with mine."

Clottey frowned slightly.

The strength of an Esper depended partly on their Grade and partly on the effect of their Esper Ability. If their Grade was the same, then the higher the Esper Ability, the more stable the advantage. For example, Gaud's Energy Control was one of the most powerful Esper Abilities. If they grew to the same level, Clottey basically had no chance of winning.

Clottey's Dark Energy Control was already a Super High Risk Esper Ability, but the other party's Esper Ability was also not simple.

Although the other party did not hit his body, he realized that his cells had become weak, and his energy consumption was much higher than usual. It was as if the other party had used energy as a medium to launch some kind of attack on him.

At this moment, this person suddenly sent out a mental message.

"Your ability is not bad. Mother Tree will definitely be very happy if I give you to her."

"The World Tree also likes to collect Esper Abilities?" Clottey thought about it and tried to ask for more information.

However, the other party did not say anything and did not respond.

Clottey thought that the other party did not want to answer, so he gave up on the idea of asking and continued to fight silently.

However, after fighting for a while, the other party suddenly spoke again.

"I'm the World Tree's Four Leaf Executive Officer, Anriin Zaro."

Clottey was stunned for a moment. He thought that the other party was going to say something, so he immediately perked up and waited.

However, after the other party said this, he did not continue for a long time and fell silent again.

Clotti frowned, feeling confused … What's the meaning of this sudden self-introduction and not saying anything else? What's the meaning of this brainless introduction?

After a while, Anriin spoke again.

"When you enter the embrace of the World Tree, we can become colleagues."

After saying this, he fell silent again. It was as if he was talking to himself and did not expect the other party to answer.

Clottey's eyelids twitched.

It's confirmed. He's a weirdo who does whatever he wants.

…

On the other side, Hella, who was wearing the Crimson Snake mechanical suit, was dealing with the siege of four people. Scarlet death energy spewed out like a flood, and the battle was extremely intense.

Compared to the other battlefields, there was a clear difference on Hella's side. When she was surrounded, there were no other Beyond Grade As coming to support her. It was as if everyone was letting her face the siege of multiple enemies alone.

Bang!

A Pugilist World Tree expert passed through the sea of death energy and caught Hella to beat her up. In the end, just as she was about to break free, he kicked her in the abdomen and sent her flying.

While Hella was flying, another World Tree expert blocked her way. A series of spells poured out and bombarded Hella's back, sending her in another direction and causing secondary damage.

Hella tried her best to stabilize her body. Suddenly, she used Death Stealth and instantly flashed to another location, obtaining a short breather.

Her entire body was covered in blood, and she looked like a ferocious ghost. She was heavily injured and weak.

Kasuyi, who was the closest, glanced over and quickly retracted his gaze. He had no intention of coming over to support her and even led his opponent further and further away.

Seeing this, one of the Holy Tree Emissaries said playfully, "You're almost dead.

Your companions are still ignoring you. No one came to help you … I didn't expect you to still have the mood to fight among yourselves in the face of our invasion. Interesting. "

Hella wiped the blood off her face as if she did not feel any pain. Her expression was still indifferent.

"No one came to help me … That's because I don't need help."

As soon as she said that, a golden light suddenly burst out from her body, and all her injuries disappeared at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Hella straightened her back, and the chaotic energy fluctuations returned to their peak. Refined death energy flowed out continuously, and her expression became stern.

"It doesn't hurt at all. With this level of skill, you're still a thousand years too early to kill me!"
